page.layout: One printed page, mostly blank. At the foot: signature "E iij" at centre-left and catchword "weist" at the right. The faint Fraktur lines in the middle and at the top are show-through from the reverse side. The library stamp is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page carries no legible printed text of its own. The faint Fraktur lines across the centre and top are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. A faint line of type just above the signature, at the very foot of the page, is too indistinct to read and is not transcribed. The rotated scan has been read as a landscape image. The library stamp "UNIVERSITY OF ILLINOIS URBANA" and the blue ink mark are not transcribed. The catchword and signature are read from the scan; the catchword is set in black letter, so the long s has been written as a plain s.
